theme: Cardiac conduction system and pacemaker electrical coupling
core_role: The shared pathways describe sinoatrial pacemaker depolarization (HCN channels) and gap-junction electrical coupling that propagate the impulse through the conduction system, framed here as the His-Purkinje conduction route that times ventricular contraction.

theme: Insulin/IGF receptor signalling through PI3K-AKT and RAS
core_role: The shared pathways are the receptor-proximal insulin/IGF1R signalling events (IRS and SHC/SOS adaptors, PI3K-AKT activation, glycogen synthesis, attenuation), framed as the upstream growth-factor input whose AKT and RAS branches are dysregulated in cancer and RASopathies.

theme: Myeloid progenitor commitment and granulocyte differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways describe the transcriptional and cytokine (PU.1, RAR, GM-CSF/CSF receptor) programme that commits myeloid progenitors to granulocyte, eosinophil and mast cell fates, read here as the lineage-resolution step at the promyelocyte stage where erythroid potential is suppressed.

theme: Hindbrain and cerebellar development underlying motor behaviour
core_role: The shared pathways concern development of the hindbrain, brainstem, pons and cerebellar Purkinje layer plus motor learning and respiratory control, framed as building the neural circuits that produce posture, locomotion, reflexes and other motor behaviours.

theme: MHC class I antigen processing and cross-presentation
core_role: The shared pathways describe processing of endogenous and exogenous (cross-presented) peptides and their loading onto MHC class I for CD8 T cells, framed here as the immune output that depends on proteasome assembly and proteasomal degradation to generate the peptides.

theme: Nephric duct and ureteric bud morphogenesis in kidney development
core_role: The shared pathways cover formation of intermediate mesoderm, the nephric/mesonephric duct and ureteric bud elongation and branching, framed as the early inductive morphogenesis of the urinary tract from which the ureteric bud is induced.

theme: tRNA and rRNA processing and modification, including mitochondria
core_role: The shared pathways are the processing and chemical modification of tRNAs and rRNAs (end processing, splicing, methylation, pseudouridylation) in nucleus and mitochondria, framed here as maturation of the RNA components needed for ribosome assembly and especially mitochondrial translation.

theme: Cardiac myocyte action potential and conduction
core_role: The shared pathways describe the rapid depolarization phase of atrial and ventricular myocyte action potentials and His-Purkinje signalling, framed as the electrical events of the full cardiac action potential (including the plateau) that couple conduction to contraction.

theme: ER protein targeting, folding, quality control and export
core_role: The shared pathways describe getting proteins into and out of the ER (SRP-dependent and tail-anchored insertion, folding, retention, COPII cargo loading and ER-to-Golgi transport), framed here as the secretory entry route whose exit is gated by ER quality control, ERAD and the unfolded protein response.

theme: Type I interferon antiviral innate immune response
core_role: The shared pathways cover RIG-I/MDA5 sensing, TRAF3/TRAF6-driven IRF and NF-kB activation, interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors (ISG15, OAS) and viral evasion, framed as the antiviral signalling cascade whose output is interferon-alpha/beta production.

theme: Heme biosynthesis and systemic iron homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways describe heme synthesis, transport and scavenging together with cellular iron import and iron-sulfur assembly, framed here as the iron-utilizing end of a system whose iron supply depends on transferrin, ferroportin and ceruloplasmin and fails in iron-overload and anaemia disorders.

theme: HDL-mediated reverse cholesterol transport and efflux
core_role: The shared pathways describe regulation of macrophage cholesterol efflux, LXR-driven efflux genes, apoA-I signalling and limitation of foam cell formation, framed as the cellular efflux step of reverse cholesterol transport that feeds HDL particle assembly.

theme: Axon guidance, repulsion and sprouting in peripheral neurons
core_role: The shared pathways describe Sema3A/plexin-mediated axon repulsion, CRMP and microtubule control, and axon extension and branching during innervation, framed here as the guidance machinery that also restrains or permits collateral sprouting and regeneration of peripheral (DRG, sympathetic) axons.

theme: Amino sugar and nucleotide-sugar metabolism for glycosylation
core_role: The shared pathways describe the hexosamine route from fructose-6-phosphate to UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid (and their genetic defects), framed as synthesis of the nucleotide-sugar donors that must then be transported into the Golgi for glycosylation, as shown by the CDG transporter defects.

theme: Host control of viral transcription, latency and integration
core_role: The shared pathways describe host activation and suppression of viral transcription, HCMV early/late events, latency and DNA integration, framed here as the viral replication-cycle steps that in retroviruses such as HIV-1 include nuclear import, integration and host restriction.

theme: Skeletal development: bone, cartilage, tendon and joints
core_role: The shared pathways describe osteoblast development, intramembranous ossification, trabecular bone, cartilage and tendon formation, framed as the tissue-building programme of skeletal morphogenesis that includes forming the joints between skeletal elements.

theme: Cytochrome P450 xenobiotic and toxin metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe oxidative metabolism of steroids, polyketides and mycotoxins such as aflatoxin by cytochrome enzymes, framed here as phase I detoxification and bioactivation alongside alcohol oxidation.

theme: Cellular responses to heavy metals and oxidative stress
core_role: The shared pathways describe MTF1-driven metallothionein binding and cellular responses to zinc, copper, iron, manganese, cobalt, lead, mercury and selenium, framed as metal detoxification that protects against metal-induced oxidative and redox stress (with HMOX1 induction).

theme: Mitochondrial energy carriers and nucleotide cofactor metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe mitochondrial ADP/ATP and NAD transport, NAD(P)+ salvage and synthesis, and phosphocreatine metabolism, framed here as maintenance of cellular energy-carrier and cofactor pools through nucleotide phosphate interconversion and creatine buffering.

theme: Regulation of insulin secretion by nutrients and incretins
core_role: The shared pathways describe beta-cell insulin processing and glucose-, fatty acid-, acetylcholine- and incretin (GLP-1, GIP)-stimulated insulin secretion plus insulin clearance, framed as the islet hormonal control of glycaemia alongside adrenergic inhibition and glucagon secretion.

theme: Meiotic recombination, synapsis and chromosome segregation
core_role: The shared pathways describe meiotic prophase I events (DSB formation and repair, synapsis, telomere attachment, recombination resolution and checkpoints), framed as the recombination stage that establishes chiasmata and cohesion needed for correct meiotic chromosome segregation.

theme: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and lipoylation
core_role: The shared pathways describe the lipoylated, DLD-dependent PDH, OGDH and OADH complexes, glycine cleavage and lysine catabolism, framed here as one enzyme family whose shared components (lipoate, DLD) also underlie BCKDH function and maple syrup urine disease.

theme: Type 2 (Th2) immunity: IL-4, IL-13, IL-5 and IL-33
core_role: The shared pathways describe Th2 differentiation and production and signalling of IL-4, IL-13, IL-5 and IL-33, framed as the type 2 immune response against helminths that activates mast cells and humoral defences.

theme: Adiponectin and insulin sensitivity in glucose uptake
core_role: The shared pathways describe adiponectin secretion and signalling and regulation of cellular glucose import and insulin responsiveness, framed here as the control of insulin sensitivity that also includes negative regulation of insulin receptor signalling and glycogen synthesis.

theme: TNFR1 and NF-kappaB signalling regulated by ubiquitin modifications
core_role: The shared pathways describe TNFR1-induced NF-kB activation and apoptosis, linear ubiquitination and SUMOylation regulating transcription factor activity, framed as an inflammatory signalling switch tuned positively and negatively by ubiquitin/SUMO and deubiquitination.

theme: Heme biosynthesis and mitochondrial iron-sulfur cluster assembly
core_role: The shared pathways describe porphyrin and heme B synthesis, mitochondrial ABC transport and cytosolic Fe-S assembly, framed here as mitochondrial iron-cofactor biogenesis that also supplies [2Fe-2S]/[4Fe-4S] clusters for TCA enzyme maturation.

theme: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and DNA replication initiation
core_role: The shared pathways describe E2F target transcription at G1/S and the initiation and regulation of mitotic DNA replication, framed as the proliferation programme that drives cell-cycle progression into S phase and on toward G2/M.

theme: ER-Golgi bidirectional vesicle transport (COPII and COPI)
core_role: The shared pathways describe COPII cargo concentration and ER export together with COPI anterograde and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic, framed as the early secretory shuttle whose vesicles must be tethered and targeted to and within the Golgi.

theme: Microtubule organization, centrosome and cilium regulation
core_role: The shared pathways describe microtubule nucleation, anchoring, severing and stability, tubulin polyglutamylation and centrosome positioning and cohesion, framed here as the centrosome-microtubule machinery that also governs centriole duplication and assembly or disassembly of the primary cilium.

theme: Chondrocyte differentiation, growth plate and articular cartilage
core_role: The shared pathways describe cartilage condensation, chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy and endochondral ossification, framed as cartilage development that builds both growth plates and joint/articular cartilage.

theme: Social, reproductive and emotional behaviours
core_role: The shared pathways describe innate social behaviours (mating, parental care, aggression, grooming) and sensorimotor gating, framed here as amygdala-linked emotional and psychomotor behaviour including exploration.

theme: Epidermal keratinocyte differentiation and skin appendage development
core_role: The shared pathways describe keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis, epidermal stem cell control, sebaceous gland and melanocyte development and wound re-epithelialization, framed as skin homeostasis that also includes hair follicle cycling and nail formation.

theme: MECP2 regulation of neuronal gene expression and excitability
core_role: The shared pathways describe MECP2 binding to methylated DNA, its regulation and Rett-associated loss of function, and its control of neuronal channels, receptors, ligands and GABA genes, framed as an epigenetic regulator of neuronal excitability and action potential signalling.

theme: Cell cycle checkpoints: RB-E2F, p53 and CDK control
core_role: The shared pathways describe CDK-cyclin regulation, RB/E2F and DREAM repression, p53-mediated arrest and G1/S and G2/M checkpoints, framed here as the proliferation control system whose deregulation drives oncogenic cell-cycle entry or senescence.

theme: Trans-Golgi network, endosome and lysosome trafficking
core_role: The shared pathways describe TGN vesicle biogenesis, Golgi-to-endosome/lysosome transport, lysosomal targeting and endosome-to-Golgi retrograde retrieval, framed as post-Golgi membrane sorting regulated by Rab GTPases and linked to constitutive secretion and endocytosis.

theme: Chromatin assembly and ATP-dependent nucleosome remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways describe nucleosome organization, replication-dependent chromatin assembly, chromatin protein recruitment and CHD remodellers, framed here as chromatin remodelling alongside the BAF (SWI/SNF) complexes and histone arginine methylation that control gene expression.

theme: RAS-MAPK signal transduction and its oncogenic mutants
core_role: The shared pathways describe RAS signal transduction to MAP2K/ERK, RSK and p38, framed as the downstream kinase cascade activated by SHC/SOS from growth factor receptors and constitutively by RAS mutants.

theme: Actin cytoskeleton remodelling and cell shape
core_role: The shared pathways describe actin filament bundling, severing, crosslinking, capping and Arp2/3 control, filopodium assembly and RHO/EPH signalling, framed as cytoskeletal regulation of cell shape and polarity coordinated with microtubules.

theme: Fertilization: sperm capacitation, acrosome reaction and egg binding
core_role: The shared pathways describe sperm capacitation, zona pellucida binding and penetration, sperm-oocyte fusion and egg activation, framed here as the fertilization sequence that depends on acrosome assembly and acrosomal exocytosis.

theme: Ubiquitin-proteasome system: ubiquitination, deubiquitination and degradation
core_role: The shared pathways describe ubiquitin activation, chain-type-specific ubiquitination, deubiquitinase families and proteasome assembly, framed as the protein-turnover system that controls protein stability and degradation together with chaperone-assisted folding.

theme: Translation termination and mRNA surveillance with ribosome rescue
core_role: The shared pathways describe translation termination, nonsense-mediated and no-go decay, and rescue of stalled ribosomes, framed as translational quality control that also degrades the nascent peptide via ribosome-associated quality control.

theme: Systemic blood pressure regulation via renin-angiotensin and vasomotor control
core_role: The shared pathways describe angiotensin generation and signalling, vasoconstriction and vasodilation (endothelin, cGMP), renal sodium and fluid excretion and neural pressure control, framed as integrated systemic arterial pressure regulation also involving vasopressin and natriuretic signalling.

theme: M-CSF/CSF1 signalling in macrophage proliferation and fusion
core_role: The shared pathways describe CSF1 receptor and interleukin receptor SHC signalling driving macrophage proliferation, responses and fusion, framed here as myeloid tyrosine kinase signalling that also involves DAP12-coupled receptors.

theme: DNA base excision repair and DNA damage reversal
core_role: The shared pathways describe glycosylase-initiated base excision repair (OGG1, MUTYH, NTHL1, NEIL), AP-site processing and single-strand break repair with their disease defects, framed as DNA base-damage repair that also includes direct alkylation reversal and TDG-mediated active demethylation.

theme: Notch receptor signalling and transcriptional output
core_role: The shared pathways describe Notch intracellular domain-driven transcription (NOTCH2-4, HLH targets) and its negative regulation, framed here as the Notch pathway that becomes constitutively active in cancer through NOTCH1 PEST mutations and FBXW7 loss.

theme: Eicosanoid metabolism: leukotrienes and lipoxins
core_role: The shared pathways describe lipoxygenase-derived synthesis of HETEs, leukotrienes, eoxins and lipoxins and their inflammatory roles, framed as eicosanoid mediator metabolism that also covers their catabolic inactivation by omega-oxidation.

theme: Nitrogen and ammonia metabolism via glutamate and urea cycle
core_role: The shared pathways describe glutamate, glutamine, aspartate, ornithine and arginine metabolism and ammonium handling, framed as nitrogen disposal and homeostasis feeding the urea cycle and arginine/citrulline synthesis.

theme: Hormonal GPCR regulation of islet secretion
core_role: The shared pathways describe glucagon, GLP-1, somatostatin, acetylcholine and fatty-acid GPCR signalling via adenylate cyclase, framed here as neuroendocrine regulation of islet insulin and glucagon secretion.

theme: Mitotic chromosome segregation: cohesion, spindle and checkpoint
core_role: The shared pathways describe sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution, PLK1/Aurora/NEK kinase signalling, spindle formation and spindle checkpoint control, framed as the machinery of mitotic chromosome segregation including establishment of cohesion and G2/M entry.

theme: Drug and xenobiotic transport and disposition (ADME)
core_role: The shared pathways describe SLCO-mediated organic anion uptake, xenobiotic export and blood-brain barrier transport and the ADME of specific drugs, framed as the transporter-driven pharmacokinetic handling of drugs and xenobiotics.
